coverageClaim: Classification and codec-foundation evidence only. These routes remain planned and are not executable until generated Lua/JS routing installs a ScriptUrlArena and proves target-specific calls.
allocationClaim: The generated URL sidecar is fixed-capacity inline storage with deterministic exhaustion and no heap fallback. This does not claim that the called Defold engine operation is allocation-free.

nativeDynamicHermes.requiredRoute: JSI string/hash values stay distinct; structured URL objects use ScriptUrlArena; Lua dispatch calls dmScript::PushURL for full URLs and leaves string/hash shorthand for dmScript::ResolveURL.

nativeStaticHermes.requiredRoute: A generated C ABI must pass the three exact 64-bit URL components into ScriptUrlArena; the current single-u64 kUrl form is rejected.

html5BrowserHost.requiredRoute: Browser glue must use an explicit three-u64 layout and generation-checked frame-local sidecar; no Number coercion or embind object marshaling.
